description: Fetch public comments posted by a specific Reddit username. Cost: 1 Credit ($0.0001) per returned comment.

limit.description: Maximum number of user comments to return (1-100, default: 25)

name: reddit_user_comments

data.description: Flattened comment list payload and optional pagination cursor

created_utc.description: Unix epoch creation timestamp in seconds

depth.description: Nesting depth starting at 0 for top-level comments

parent_id.description: Immediate parent comment or post ID

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page

meta.description: Response metadata including request ID, billing credits used, and cache status

cache_hit.description: Whether the response was served from L1 cache

credits_used.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on cache error/empty)
